requirement: R4 (on-paper cache-cannot-match argument) instantiated on one concrete frozen env
subordinate_to: L-015; on any conflict L-015 governs. Inherits its formal object, frozen baseline family, R1-R6, decision table, H_null verbatim. Adds no threshold, weakens no baseline, adds no schema.

environment_E_star.factors: row r in {1..n} (type), col k in {1..n} (context); n large e.g. 20; squareness not required
environment_E_star.latent_code: a:{1..n}->Z_L, b:{1..n}->Z_L i.i.d. uniform over Z_L={0..L-1}, L>=3 (concrete L=5); codes LATENT, never observed, never in any field
environment_E_star.outcome_rule: phi(r,k) = (a(r)+b(k)) mod L = additive Cayley table over Z_L = a Latin square

coverage_conditions.C1_novel_combination: every test cell (r*,k*) not in Omega_train (cache-void by absence)
coverage_conditions.C2_marginal_cover_and_balance: each factor individually observed with other partners (learnable); training partners' residues mod L (near-)uniform so every single-factor marginal of y is (near-)uniform
coverage_conditions.C3_connectivity: G_train bipartite graph connected -> a,b identifiable up to a global additive constant; y=a+b invariant to it, so y[r*,k*] fully identified by solving the connected additive system. C3 is what lets learners solve the STATIONARY regime and is exactly what R4(b) must break.

structural_properties.P1_marginal_balance: one-factor information is zero information about y
structural_properties.P2_joint_determinacy: recovering (a(r),b(k)) via matrix completion / additive fit solves any cell incl held-out

R4a_cache_void_proof.verdict: HOLDS on paper: every frozen cache member = chance (1/L) on Omega_test
R4a_cache_void_proof.lemma: cache members use only: (i) exact cell (absent by C1), (ii) single-factor marginals (uniform by P1), (iii) one-factor-overlap retrieval (independent residues). Each is independent of y[r*,k*]=(a(r*)+b(k*)) mod L under the uniform-code prior => MI=0 => expected accuracy = 1/L. Finite-sample bounded by pre-registered MDE, self-tested at STEP-A.

per_member.count_table: key (r*,k*) count 0 (C1); backoff to uniform marginal (P1) => 1/L; cannot form a(r*)+b(k*) (that is the learner)
per_member.transition_table: same tuple-keyed lookup, unseen held-out key -> backoff => 1/L; factor-wise dynamics carry no cross-term info
per_member.successor_map: novel key; nearest stored key differs one factor, value off by independent residue (uniform mod L) => 1/L
per_member.episodic_traversal: nearest neighbour shares one factor; E[match]=P[b(k_j)==b(k*)]=1/L; voting over many same-row neighbours = i.i.d. uniform => 1/L
per_member.rag_summary: retrieved set shares one factor, labels i.i.d. uniform in target residue class -> summary uninformative => 1/L

R4a_cache_void_proof.boundary_statement: the ONLY sufficient statistic recovering y[r*,k*] is the reconstructed pair (a,b) via matrix completion / additive-model fit = a LEARNING op, performed by no enumerated cache member.
R4a_cache_void_proof.adversarial_anti_smuggling: a cache member strengthened until it fits the additive/log-linear model has LEFT the cache family and JOINED the learning sub-family; adjudicated by R3/R4(b), not credited as cache pass. STEP-A R1 self-test asserts each cache member macro-acc <= 1/L + MDE; exceeding => leakage (R5) or mislabeled learner => STOP.
R4a_cache_void_proof.group_identity_note: the group identity y[r*,k*]=(y[r*,k0]+y[r0,k*]-y[r0,k0]) mod L (a 2x2 additive minor / 3-point completion) DOES reconstruct the held-out cell from three stored cells, but evaluating it is modular additive arithmetic over retrieved labels = the additive-model fit itself, performed by no enumerated cache member (retrieval returns a label/vote; count returns an argmax; none combine labels as label_A+label_B-label_C mod L). This IS the cache/learner boundary.

R4b_regime_G_star.verdict: NAMES a testable regime + its decisive challenger; does NOT establish headroom on paper (OPEN)

regime_spec.sparse_disconnected_slices: each episode reveals small slice S_e, |S_e|<<n, G_{S_e} disconnected/under-determined; connectivity only over UNION of many episodes -> identifiability requires cross-episode aggregation
regime_spec.recurring_nonstationarity: code drawn from small latent library {(a^1,b^1)..(a^g,b^g)}, switches between episodes so regimes RECUR NON-ADJACENTLY (Markov/interleaved)
regime_spec.bounded_online_compute: per-step O(|S_e|); cannot re-solve full accumulated system each step
regime_spec.deployment_resampled_library: regime library resampled per deployment/meta-test -> no fixed amortized obs->code map transfers; identify within deployment
regime_spec.heldout: novel cells of a regime whose non-adjacent slices union to connected; cache-void per Section 2 regime-by-regime

failure_geography.online_no_replay: bounded compute + single pass; cannot back-solve emergent-connectivity system; forgets across switching -> fails
failure_geography.from_scratch_per_task_deployment: needs batch solve (=R6 batch control) AND segmentation
failure_geography.vanilla_experience_replay: regime-blind uniform replay POOLS across interleaved regimes -> averaged wrong code -> fails
failure_geography.standard_continual_replay_regime_blind: averages across regimes or discards non-adjacent same-regime evidence -> fails unless augmented with regime inference (=> becomes the challenger)
failure_geography.strong_meta_learner: deployment-resampling defeats amortizing specific codes; can only amortize the procedure segment+pool+solve which IS the consolidation mechanism (baseline equivalence) unless procedure fails to transfer

R4b_regime_G_star.residual_headroom_hypothesis: offline consolidation = unbounded retrospective re-processing that (i) segments stream by regime, (ii) RETROACTIVELY links non-adjacent same-regime episodes, (iii) pools sparse slices into a connected per-regime system and solves it, (iv) writes regime-indexed schema to C. Headroom source = offline GLOBAL RETROACTIVE linkage a forward-only bounded regime-blind online learner cannot do.
R4b_regime_G_star.strongest_challenger_to_beat: standard_continual_replay instantiated as DRIFT-AWARE / REGIME-INFERRING continual learner: online change-point detection + regime-indexed replay buffer + per-regime online additive/low-rank completion. Still a learning-sub-family member. H_null: it MATCHES the kernel in G* (segment+pool can be done online-incrementally). Restates N2 'constraint propagation belongs in the floor' as 'drift-aware replay belongs in the learning family'.

narrow_testable_cracks.retroactive_re_segmentation: online change-point mis-assigns early episodes and cannot un-mix; offline global clustering corrects. Falsifier: give online challenger a look-back re-labeling buffer; gap closes => no headroom.
narrow_testable_cracks.bounded_resource_asymmetry: offline re-solve under SAME data budget but a memory/compute budget where BATCH is inadmissible (batch needs all cells resident). Only defensible headroom is RESOURCE-BOUNDED. Falsifier: unbounded-budget batch additive-fit + segmentation matches => R6 downgrade 'offline==batch'.

R4b_regime_G_star.honest_narrowing: kernel BEST-CASE positive = RESOURCE-BOUNDED headroom over {online_no_replay, vanilla_experience_replay, regime-blind standard_continual_replay} in G* -- NOT over unbounded batch, NOT over the drift-aware regime-inferring continual learner unless both cracks empirically hold. Prior that they do not (H_null) is LIKELY.

R1_R6_mapping.R1: SATISFIED by construction; STEP-A self-test each cache member <= 1/L + MDE
R1_R6_mapping.R2: DEFERRED to STEP-B; corrupted-replay AND no-replay must destroy gain; necessary-not-sufficient (challenger collapses too)
R1_R6_mapping.R3: frozen family unchanged; decisive member in G* = drift-aware regime-inferring continual learner; tie = baseline equivalence
R1_R6_mapping.R5: O = factor indices + outcomes only; no field encodes a,b, target, or LATENT regime id; names carry no label; exposing regime id leaks segmentation -> forbidden
R1_R6_mapping.R6: beat (i) vanilla replay (fails by mixing) AND (ii) batch-precompute on same data (HARD; escape only via bounded-memory making batch inadmissible); plus non-memorization (C1 guarantees held-out not epsilon-close in cell space)

decision.R4b: NAMES testable regime G* + decisive challenger
decision.gate_outcome: decision-table ROW 3 (PROCEED to draft kernel STEP-A) -- QUALIFIED: R4(b) does not establish paper headroom; it locates the single decisive contrast; honest prior H_null = TIE = downgrade
decision.cheapest_validation_step: do NOT build full kernel first; scope STEP-A first experiment to the decisive contrast (kernel vs drift-aware regime-inferring continual replay in G*, equal data + stated budget) as a tiny CPU toy (small n, L=5, g in {2,3}). Tie within equivalence band => STOP/downgrade before kernel plumbing.

falsifiers.F1: any cache member > 1/L + MDE on Omega_test -> R5 leakage or mislabeled learner -> STOP
falsifiers.F2: drift-aware regime-inferring continual learner matches consolidator in G* (equal data+budget) -> baseline equivalence -> downgrade (expected H_null)
falsifiers.F3: batch-precompute matches consolidator at kernel budget -> 'offline==batch' -> R6 downgrade
falsifiers.F4: connectivity within one episode OR non-resampled library -> whole learning family solves -> no headroom -> redesign/close
falsifiers.F5: same-regime slices never union to connected -> Omega_test unidentifiable theta-free -> env_impossible; do not auto-build to reach it

claim_ceiling: design + pre-registration only; cannot show kernel success, mechanism validity, learning, headroom existence, agency, self, emotion, consciousness, or EGO readiness. Passing authorizes only DRAFTING the kernel STEP-A card.
what_this_does_not_prove: nothing about kernel success, mechanism validity, learning, headroom existence, belief maintenance, agency, autonomy, subjectivity, emotion, self-awareness, consciousness, stable user benefit, or EGO readiness. It fixes one env where the cache family is provably at chance and names one testable regime whose most probable outcome is a bounded baseline-equivalence negative.
